name: What is the step-by-step process for a cabin finish upgrade?

mainEntity.name: What is the step-by-step process for a cabin finish upgrade?

acceptedAnswer.text: The project begins with a detailed inspection of the timber, chinking, and interior spaces to identify drafts, surface wear, or moisture damage. The crew then preps the wood by washing away dirt, pollen, and loose finish, followed by careful sanding or localized scraping where coatings have degraded. Next, fresh stain and protective sealants are applied in even coats. Once the building envelope is sealed, interior finish upgrades proceed, including caulking joints, repairing interior drywall, installing decorative trim, or updating tile features. Owner Abraham Becerra oversees the work on-site to maintain quality across every phase.
acceptedAnswer.description: The process involves inspecting timber and joints, cleaning and surface prep, applying stain and sealants, repairing chinking, and completing interior finish carpentry.
